×61

MLA latent attention

187,107,328 parameters per layer; 128 heads, Q/K dimension 192 per head, V dimension 128 per head.

Query branch

Q down / wq_a7168 → 1536W [1536,7168]; 11,010,048 parameters
↓
RMSNorm γ [1536][B,T,1536]
↓
Q up / wq_b1536 → 24576W [24576,1536]; 37,748,736 parameters
↓
reshape + split[B,T,128,128] + [B,T,128,64]First 128 dimensions without RoPE; last 64 with RoPE; concatenated Q has 192 dimensions

Key / Value branch

KV down + positional K / wkv_a7168 → 576 = 512+64W [576,7168]; 4,128,768 parameters
↓
latent RMSNorm γ [512][B,T,512]The separate 64-dimensional K uses RoPE and is shared across 128 heads
↓
KV up / wkv_b512 → 32768W [32768,512]; 16,777,216 parameters
↓
Split content K and V per head[B,T,128,128] ×2Concatenate content K with shared 64-dimensional positional K → K [B,T,128,192]; V remains 128-dimensional
Q·Kᵀ × scale + causal mask → softmax[B,128,T,S]Scale includes the YaRN adjustment; RoPE, masking and softmax have no trainable parameters
↓
attention × V → concat heads[B,T,16384]
↓
o_proj / wo → 7168[B,T,7168]W [7168,16384]; 117,440,512 parameters
  • Q/K head_dim=128+64, not 7168/128.
  • The explicit path materializes K/V; the official default absorb path algebraically rearranges the same matrices without adding parameters.
  • KV cache per token per layer: 512-dimensional latent + 64-dimensional positional K. Cache is runtime state, not model parameters.
  • q_lora_rank is an intrinsic low-rank architecture choice, not an added fine-tuning adapter.

×58

DeepSeekMoE routing and experts

11,320,164,608 parameters per layer; 257 experts with 44,040,192 parameters each.

Gate/up branches in each expert

gate_proj / w1 + SiLU7168 → 2048W [2048,7168]; 14,680,064 parameters
↓
up_proj / w37168 → 2048W [2048,7168]; multiplied elementwise with the gate output
↓
down_proj / w22048 → 7168W [7168,2048]; 14,680,064 parameters
Router linear → sigmoid[B·T,256]W [256,7168]; 1,835,008 parameters
↓
Add correction bias for selection only[B·T,8,32]Sum the top-2 corrected scores per group; select the top-4 groups
↓
Select the top-8 experts within retained groups[B·T,8]Mixture weights use original sigmoid scores, normalized over selected experts and scaled by 2.5
↓
shared(x) + Σ₈ weightₑ × expertₑ(x)[B,T,7168]
  • Each expert: w2(SiLU(w1(x)) ⊙ w3(x)); no bias.
  • Routed expert repetitions=58×256=14,848; shared expert repetitions=58.
  • One correction bias [256] per layer, updated by load-balancing rules rather than standard gradients.
